title: Evens only
prompt: Return a new array containing only the even numbers from nums, in their original order.
hints: A loop with an if inside it, appending only when the test passes.

docs.name: for item in list:
docs.what: Runs the indented lines once per item, with item holding each value in turn.

docs.name: a % b
docs.what: The remainder after dividing a by b.

docs.name: list.append(value)
docs.what: Adds value to the end of the array. Returns nothing.
